questions.question: Which bean does spring-boot-starter-mail give you for sending messages?
questions.explanation: The starter creates a JavaMailSender when spring.mail.host is set, and you inject it into your service.

questions.question: When do you use MimeMessage instead of SimpleMailMessage?
options: For HTML bodies, attachments or inline images
questions.explanation: SimpleMailMessage handles plain text. MimeMessage, usually built with MimeMessageHelper, supports HTML and attachments.

questions.question: The mail server is not running. The code catches MailException around mailSender.send(message) and prints "Mail could not be sent". What is printed?
options: The app crashes with no message
The mail is sent later automatically
questions.explanation: When the connection fails, Spring throws a MailSendException, which is a MailException, so the catch block runs.

questions.question: Which two properties are needed for a local test server on port 1025?
questions.explanation: spring.mail.host and spring.mail.port tell the JavaMailSender where the SMTP server listens.

questions.question: Code calls helper.addAttachment(...) on a MimeMessageHelper created with new MimeMessageHelper(message, "UTF-8"). It fails. What is the bug?
options: The attachment name is too short
Multipart mode was not turned on, so the constructor needs true as the second argument
questions.explanation: Attachments need a multipart message, which is enabled with new MimeMessageHelper(message, true, "UTF-8").
